saw_lines: Drinkware buyers ask one thing first, will it keep ice cold all day, then they buy again for a new design.
So the sale is won in line one, where a buyer asking how it arrives either gets an answer or scrolls past.
Your site offers 15% off, yet 0 of 26 ads mention it, so put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 18 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 15% off, yet 0 of 26 ads mention percent off, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put the 15% off offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site answers shipping questions, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer asking about arrival gets no answer. Lead new buyer ads with the free shipping offer over $70 in line one.

0 of 26 ad bodies carry a proof number, and the 30,000+ reviews sit only in description lines, so readers see no number. Collect a figure, such as orders shipped or a customer count, and open three new ads with it.

Four Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product they show, so the click lands on a general page. Point each to the product or collection its creative shows, such as the Universal Buddy for can cooler ads.

ads_1: Offer and shipping led creative for new buyers, tested against the can cooler hook
